About.title: About Us
About.subtitle: A custom cap and hat factory in Guangzhou, China, making caps for brands since 2015.
About.storyText: NanCrown started in 2015 as a small cap workshop in Guangzhou, China. Today we are a 2,000 m² factory with a team of more than 30 people, making over 100,000 caps a month for brands in more than 50 countries.
About.capacityText: Our workshop covers about 2,000 m² with a team of more than 30 people. With cutting, sewing and assembly on our own floor, and long-term partners for embroidery and printing, we make over 100,000 caps a month, so we can take a 50-piece trial and a large repeat order alike.
About.certificationsText: Every order is checked at each stage of production, and bulk only starts after you approve a pre-production sample. Before the order ships, we send you photos of the finished caps, and you can also check them on a live video call or through a third-party inspector.
About.storyText2: We work directly with the people who own the brand: clothing and streetwear labels, running and outdoor brands, surf shops, companies and event organisers. You send the idea and the logo; we turn it into a sample, and once you approve it, we make the order to match.

faq.q: Are you a factory or a trading company?
faq.a: A factory. Pattern making, cutting, sewing and assembly are done on our own floor in Guangzhou, China, and we work directly with brand owners. Embroidery, printing and washing are done by long-term partner workshops and checked by us.
In Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, China. We ship to customers in more than 50 countries by courier, air or sea freight.

faq.q: Can I see the factory before I order?
faq.a: Yes. You can watch our workshop video on this site, or ask for a live video call and we will show you the floor. You can also send a third-party inspector to check your order before it ships.

faq.q: What is the smallest order you take?
faq.a: 50 pieces per colour, per style. Two colours of one style can be combined to reach the 100-piece price tier.
Carrie from our sales team answers every inquiry personally, usually within 1–2 business days (Guangzhou time, GMT+8).

FAQ.title: FAQ
FAQ.subtitle: Our most frequently asked questions
FAQ.q1: How long is your production time?
FAQ.a1: Our standard production time is 25–30 days, depending on quantity and customization complexity. Rush orders can be arranged — contact us to discuss your timeline.
FAQ.q2: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
FAQ.a2: Our MOQ starts from 50 pieces per colour. For first-time orders, we offer flexible quantities to help you test the market.
FAQ.q3: Can you produce custom designs with our logo?
FAQ.a3: Absolutely! We offer full customization including embroidery, screen printing, woven labels, patches, and more. Just send us your logo and design requirements.
FAQ.a4: We work with a wide range of materials including cotton twill, polyester, nylon, wool, acrylic, corduroy, and organic/recycled fabrics. We can also source specific materials per your request.
FAQ.a5: We offer FOB, CIF, and door-to-door delivery options worldwide. We work with reliable freight forwarders and can ship by sea, air, or express courier depending on your needs.
FAQ.q6: Do you provide samples before production?
FAQ.a6: Yes, we provide pre-production samples for your approval. Sample production takes 7–15 days. Once approved, we proceed with mass production.

HomeA.lead: A 2,000 m² cap factory in Guangzhou, China — our own cutting, sewing and assembly lines, backed by long-term embroidery, printing and finishing partners. We work directly with brand owners who need a manufacturing partner, not just a listing.
